create_pipeline_fabric: create a Stable Diffusion pipeline with feedback-conditioned text-to-image generation using liked and disliked images
run_fabric_cross_attention: run custom cross-attention with weighted feedback conditioning on attention probabilities in the UNet transformer blocks
cache_unet_hidden_states: cache UNet transformer block hidden states during a forward pass for reuse with feedback-conditioned inference
preprocess_feedback_images: preprocess liked and disliked reference images into VAE latents for feedback-guided image generation
generate_feedback_conditional_images: generate images conditioned on positive and negative feedback with tunable weight schedules across denoising timesteps
